title: Oven Roasted Jamaican Bean Stew
description: A peppery and flavorful one-pot Jamaican dish featuring chilli bean paste, this paleo-friendly stew is made with double-rise-bread and cooked to perfection in a Korean brass bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Korean brass bowl, combine the chilli bean paste, onion, garlic, carrots, celery, and diced tomatoes.
Add the melted coconut oil, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Add the cubed double-rise-bread to the bowl and toss until the bread is evenly coated with the stew mixture.
Cover the bowl with a lid and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 15 minutes, or until the bread is toasted and the stew is hot and bubbly.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
